system.description:
Once per encounter, as part of your action, each enemy of your choice within 10ft that can see you makes a Will save against your Class Save DC (using Charisma) or is Frightened until the end of its next turn.

Available to: Fighters, Barbarians, Knights, Paladins, Spellblades, Bards, Rangers, Archers, Gunslingers, Swashbucklers, Rogues, Assassins, and Monks.
